name: fullgr_extended
title: Extended system: Lindblom-Detweiler + axion (verified)
description: Compact form used by the integrators of the beyond-Cowling modes. Every equation was checked to follow from the action (checks of this module).

H1'.label: extended system, equation for H1'
H1'.ref: LD (metric Q, corrected sign) + new axion terms; verified against the derived system
H1'.text: -8*pi*G*r**2*H1(r)*V(a0(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + r*Derivative(H1(r), r) - (-16*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*calV(r) + H0(r) + K(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + (4*pi*G*r**2*(-(-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) - 2*epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + l + (1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 1)*H1(r)

K'.label: extended system, equation for K'
K'.ref: LD (metric Q, corrected sign) + new axion terms; verified against the derived system
K'.text: -8*pi*G*f_a*r*deltatheta(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r) + 8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*W(r)*exp(lambda0(r)) + r*Derivative(K(r), r) - ((l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*H1(r) - (-l + r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 1)*K(r) - H0(r)

W'.label: extended system, equation for W'
W'.ref: LD (metric Q, corrected sign) + new axion terms; verified against the derived system

X'.label: extended system, equation for X'
X'.ref: LD (metric Q, corrected sign) + new axion terms; verified against the derived system
X'.text: l*X(r) + r*Derivative(X(r), r) - ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*((-r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + 1)*H0(r) + (3*r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 1)*K(r) + (omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*H1(r) + (-8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(lambda0(r)) - 2*omega**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) + lambda0(r)) + r**2*(-2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/r**2 + 2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), (r, 2))/r**2 - 4*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r**3))*W(r) - (2*(l - 1)*(l + 2) + 4)*calV(r)*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 - (f_a*r*n0(r)*Derivative(deltatheta(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) - l*(l + 1)*calV(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r))/r + r*(H0(r)/2 + K(r))*n0(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) + (n0(r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r))**2 + Derivative(a0(r), r)**2*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), (a0(r), 2)) - 4*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r))/r)*W(r)*n0(r)*exp(-lambda0(r)) + (-4*pi*G*f_a*r*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*Derivative(a0(r), r) + f_a*r*n0(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), (a0(r), 2)) + f_a*(l + r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r))*n0(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)))*deltatheta(r))*exp(Phi0(r))

H0.label: extended system, equation for H0
H0.ref: LD (metric Q, corrected sign) + new axion terms; verified against the derived system
H0.text: 8*pi*G*f_a*r*(r*Derivative(deltatheta(r), r) + (l + r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + 2)*deltatheta(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r) + 4*pi*G*r**2*H0(r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)**2 - 8*pi*G*r**2*X(r)*exp(-Phi0(r)) + 8*pi*G*r*W(r)*n0(r)*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) + (-omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) - 2*lambda0(r)) + r*((l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r))*H1(r) - (-omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) - r*(r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 1)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2)*K(r) + (r*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*H0(r)

V.label: extended system, equation for V
V.ref: LD (metric Q, corrected sign) + new axion terms; verified against the derived system
V.text: f_a*(deltatheta(r) + W(r)*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)/(f_a*r))*n0(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r))/(omega**2*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))) + calV(r) - (-H0(r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 + X(r)/((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) - W(r)*exp(Phi0(r) + lambda0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r)*exp(Phi0(r))/omega**2

KG.label: extended system, equation for KG
KG.ref: LD (metric Q, corrected sign) + new axion terms; verified against the derived system
KG.text: -16*pi*G*deltatheta(r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)**2 - (-n0(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r))/f_a + 2*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)/f_a)*H0(r) + (Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - Derivative(lambda0(r), r) + (2*l + 2)/r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(deltatheta(r), r) + (l*(Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - Derivative(lambda0(r), r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))/r + l*(-1 + exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*(l + 1)/r**2 + omega**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) - (f_a**2*n0(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), (a0(r), 2)) + f_a**2*Derivative(V(a0(r)), (a0(r), 2)))/f_a**2)*deltatheta(r) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(deltatheta(r), (r, 2)) - deltan(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r))/f_a

checks.name: Parte sin traza de las ecuaciones angulares: H2 = H0, sin contribución del axión
Métrica congelada (H0 = H1 = K = 0): las cuatro ecuaciones de materia son las de Cowling (paso 5)
Bianchi: G_tt linealizada es redundante (con axión)
Bianchi: la traza angular linealizada es redundante (con axión)
La ligadura algebraica de H0 se conserva al integrar (su derivada se anula con el sistema)
Sin axión: H1', K', W', H0 y V de Lindblom-Detweiler (Zhao y Lattimer, arXiv:2204.03037)
X' de Zhao y Lattimer: no coincide tal cual; con -2 w^2 en el término de W, sí (errata de signo)
Burgio et al. (arXiv:1106.2736): W' coincide; H1', K', X', H0 y V fallan tal cual y coinciden con una corrección mínima cada una
Kunjipurayil et al. (arXiv:2205.02081, coautor T. Zhao): las seis coinciden, X' con -2 w^2
Zhang et al. (arXiv:2601.21911): H1', K', W', X' y H0 coinciden, escritas ya con las cinco correcciones de Burgio et al.; en V pone w^3 donde va w^2
Control negativo: 16 pi -> 8 pi en H1' de LD se detecta
Exterior sin axión: Z = r^{l+2}(K - e^psi H1)/(nr+3M) cumple la ecuación de Zerilli
Exterior con axión (theta_0 = 0): delta theta no ve la métrica y cumple la Ec. (13) del Paper II
Centro: H0(0) = K(0), H1(0) = [2l K(0) + 16 pi G (eps+p) W(0)]/[l(l+1)] y V(0) = -W(0)/l, como en LD, sin corrección axiónica
Centro: X(0) = X_LD(0) + e^{Phi_c}[n dm*/dtheta Delta theta(0) - (8 pi G/3)(eps+p) V(theta_c) W(0)]
Centro: delta theta''(0) = Ec. (16c) del Paper II - 3 K(0) theta_0''(0)/(2l+3)
Sistema extendido, H1': se sigue de la acción
Sistema extendido, K': se sigue de la acción
Sistema extendido, W' (sin cambios): se sigue de la acción
Sistema extendido, X': se sigue de la acción
Sistema extendido, relación algebraica de H0: se sigue de la acción
Sistema extendido, relación algebraica de V: se sigue de la acción
Sistema extendido, Klein-Gordon: Ec. (8d) + términos métricos: se sigue de la acción
Todos los términos nuevos se anulan sin axión
Control negativo: quitar el flujo 8 pi G r f_a^2 theta_0' delta theta de K' se detecta
